description: This file defines the implementation of the LoanAccountLockService, specifically the class LoanAccountLockServiceImpl, which manages locking mechanisms for loan accounts during the Close of Book (COB) process. It includes methods for retrieving locked loans, checking if a loan is hard locked or lock-overridable, and updating/removing locks.

classes.name: LoanAccountLockServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing loan account locks during COB process, providing methods to query and manipulate lock states.

methods.name: getLockedLoanAccountByPage
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of locked loan accounts.

methods.name: isLoanHardLocked
methods.description: Checks if a specific loan is hard locked due to COB processing locks.

methods.name: isLockOverrulable
methods.description: Determines if the lock on a loan is overrule-able based on error presence.

methods.name: updateCobAndRemoveLocks
methods.description: Updates loans from account locks and removes the locks in a new transaction boundary.
